steps.text: The local brush model suggests the main issue is directional drag: a straight path leaves most ink behind the tip, and shifting every path forward creates excess ink around corners. I’m keeping the first pass near an 8 mm press and using the target’s medial paths, then I’ll use the scored replay to adjust path direction and coverage based on the actual sheet.
